content: Outer race spall fault detected on motor M-104 SKF6310 bearing at ISO Stage 3. BPFO vibration amplitude reached 8.2 mm/s RMS, exceeding Stage 3 threshold. Kurtosis 6.4. Temperature elevated to 74 deg C. Root cause: fatigue spalling from extended operation past recommended replacement interval combined with inadequate lubrication replenishment. Action taken: planned emergency bearing replacement during 6-hour maintenance window on Wednesday 06:00. Parts used: SKF6310-ZZ deep groove ball bearing. Crew performed LOTO isolation, removed motor from service, pressed out degraded bearing, inspected shaft for scoring, installed new SKF6310-ZZ, re-lubricated with Mobilux EP2. Post-repair vibration baseline reset at 1.1 mm/s RMS, temperature normalised to 38 deg C within 2 hours. Risk avoidance: prevented imminent seizure estimated at $619K production loss. Lessons learned: schedule bearing replacement every 18 months or 8000 operating hours for SKF6310 in motor class assets. Lubrication intervals should not exceed 6 weeks under Stage 2+ vibration. Post-repair historian baselines must be updated in SCADA within 24 hours.
